metadata.title: Rego Policy Libraries — fedramp (FedRAMP — Federal Risk and Authorization Management Program)

groups.title: FedRAMP — Federal Risk and Authorization Management Program

controls.title: FedRAMP: Service is not FedRAMP authorized and not in process. Federal agencies may only use FedRAMP authorized cloud services for federal data.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: FedRAMP: Service is not FedRAMP authorized and not in process. Federal agencies may only use FedRAMP authorized cloud services for federal data.

controls.title: FedRAMP: Authorization type '%v' is not valid. Must be ATO (Agency) or P-ATO (JAB).

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: FedRAMP: Authorization type '%v' is not valid. Must be ATO (Agency) or P-ATO (JAB).

controls.title: FedRAMP: ATO/P-ATO expires in %v days. Initiate renewal at least 90 days before expiration.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: FedRAMP: ATO/P-ATO expires in %v days. Initiate renewal at least 90 days before expiration.

controls.title: Cryptographic modules are not FIPS 140-2 or 140-3 validated. FedRAMP requires FIPS-validated cryptography for federal data.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Cryptographic modules are not FIPS 140-2 or 140-3 validated. FedRAMP requires FIPS-validated cryptography for federal data.

controls.title: FedRAMP: FIPS 140-2 validation level must be at least Level 1. Level 2 is required for sensitive applications.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: FedRAMP: FIPS 140-2 validation level must be at least Level 1. Level 2 is required for sensitive applications.

controls.title: Cryptographic algorithm '%v' is not approved for federal use. Use NSA Suite B or CNSA Suite algorithms.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Cryptographic algorithm '%v' is not approved for federal use. Use NSA Suite B or CNSA Suite algorithms.

controls.title: FedRAMP: Federal data stored in non-US location '%v'. FedRAMP requires federal data to remain within US territories unless explicitly authorized.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: FedRAMP: Federal data stored in non-US location '%v'. FedRAMP requires federal data to remain within US territories unless explicitly authorized.

controls.title: FedRAMP: Federal data processed in non-US location '%v'. Data processing must occur within US territories.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: FedRAMP: Federal data processed in non-US location '%v'. Data processing must occur within US territories.

controls.title: Personnel '%v' has administrative access but is not a US person and has no foreign national waiver. Moderate/High requires US persons for admin access.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Personnel '%v' has administrative access but is not a US person and has no foreign national waiver. Moderate/High requires US persons for admin access.

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: Personnel '%v' has administrative access without a completed background check. Background checks are required for all admin personnel.

controls.title: No Continuous Monitoring (ConMon) program documented. FedRAMP requires a formal ConMon program.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: No Continuous Monitoring (ConMon) program documented. FedRAMP requires a formal ConMon program.

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: Monthly ConMon report has not been submitted to the authorizing official. Monthly reporting is required.

controls.title: Monthly vulnerability scans are not configured. FedRAMP requires vulnerability scans of all system components monthly.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Monthly vulnerability scans are not configured. FedRAMP requires vulnerability scans of all system components monthly.

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: Last vulnerability scan was %v days ago. FedRAMP requires monthly scanning.

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: Monthly OS-level vulnerability scans are not configured. Separate OS-level scans are required.

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: Web application scans are not configured. FedRAMP requires web application vulnerability scanning.

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: Database vulnerability scans are not configured. FedRAMP requires database scanning for systems with databases.

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: High-severity vulnerabilities have been open for %v days. FedRAMP requires remediation of High vulnerabilities within 30 days.

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: Critical vulnerabilities have been open for %v days. FedRAMP requires remediation of Critical vulnerabilities within 15 days.

controls.title: System has not been assessed by a FedRAMP-recognized Third Party Assessment Organization (3PAO). 3PAO assessment is required for authorization.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: System has not been assessed by a FedRAMP-recognized Third Party Assessment Organization (3PAO). 3PAO assessment is required for authorization.

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: Last 3PAO assessment was %v days ago. Annual third-party assessment is required to maintain authorization.

controls.title: Annual penetration testing is not configured. Moderate and High systems require annual pen testing.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Annual penetration testing is not configured. Moderate and High systems require annual pen testing.

controls.title: Incident response plan has not been reviewed and approved. Moderate/High systems require an approved IR plan.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Incident response plan has not been reviewed and approved. Moderate/High systems require an approved IR plan.

controls.title: High-impact systems require alternative processing sites. No redundant processing site is configured.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: High-impact systems require alternative processing sites. No redundant processing site is configured.

controls.title: High-impact systems require two-person rule for critical operations. Implement dual authorization.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: High-impact systems require two-person rule for critical operations. Implement dual authorization.

controls.title: No supply chain risk management plan. Moderate and High systems must assess and manage supply chain risks.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: No supply chain risk management plan. Moderate and High systems must assess and manage supply chain risks.

controls.title: Component '%v' provenance has not been verified. Component origin must be verified for Moderate/High systems.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Component '%v' provenance has not been verified. Component origin must be verified for Moderate/High systems.
